verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly retains manual prize claiming as an implementation-relevant smart-contract behavior.
The client changes prize collection to a one-click interaction on the Winners page and supplies its claim URL.
The approved FAQ replaces the one-click prize-claim link with a new product URL.
The client leaves the implemented prize-collection behavior unresolved between automatic delivery and a claim button.
The client replaces one-click claiming with automatic wallet delivery and winner visibility on the Winners page and dashboard; email notification belongs to the separate winner-email Requirement.
The only new rule is conditional winner email notification, which belongs to REQ_PRIZE_WINNER_EMAIL_NOTIFICATION; the claim-flow fields merely repeat existing behavior.
Target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer reports that the claim button is conditionally displayed only during the applicable period.
The client accepts the one-click claim interaction and its conditional visibility, replacing the previously specified automatic collection method.
